title: A stock price alert
description:
Raise events when a price changes and let several listeners react.

```
AAPL 180.00 -> 182.50 (+1.4%)
ALERT: AAPL moved more than 1%
AAPL 182.50 -> 182.70 (+0.1%)
3 changes logged
```
hints: In the setter: `if (value == _price) return; var old = _price; _price = value; PriceChanged?.Invoke(this, new PriceChangedEventArgs(old, value));` (lesson 4.02).
The percentage is `(new - old) / old * 100`; `:+0.0;-0.0` shows the sign.
requirements: `class Stock` with `event EventHandler<PriceChangedEventArgs>? PriceChanged`, raised only when the price really changes.
`PriceChangedEventArgs` holds the old and new price.
Two listeners: one prints every change, one prints an alert over 1%; a lambda counts the changes.
Show that unsubscribing (`-=`) stops a listener.
stretch: Keep a history and add a method that returns the biggest single move.
